text: Curriculum Introduction: The standard Chinese language training program is designed for students who want to know more about Chinese culture and improve their Chinese language skills .The classes attach the equal importance of listening, speaking, reading and writing Chinese in order to lay a solid foundation for students on the basis of practicality. Prospects This short-term Chinese language program stresses on basic Chinese training and focuses on students' listening and speaking practice. It also combines with a certain amount of social activities and practices to learn Chinese culture and life , which will be of great benefit for you in your study and life in China. Through the 6-month study, students will be able to master almost 500 Chinese characters, and be familiar with at least 30 kinds of daily communication scenes. They will be able to have basic daily communication with native Chinese speaker and to live in China without difficulty. Cultural Activities and Field Trips We arrange free field trips to historical sites every semester and organize rich cultural activities like singing contests, sports matches, recitation, learning of Chinese classical musical instruments , individual talent performance and so on. Low tuition fee Usually, courses taught in English is very high. After our foundation class, you can choose Chinese-medium course, which will save you a lot. 2.Promising employment prospect Known by all, China is the world's second largest economy after the United States. Studying in China will offer you a chance to join more international groups and realize yourself in the global work market. 3. More scholarship chance In China, scholarships are usually set up in Chinese Course. So, if you apply a Chinese course, you will get more chance to get scholarship. 4. A trend to speak Chinese Nowadays, it is a trend to study Chinese among royal families and rich people around the world. Speaking Chinese certainly gives you more options to start your fantastic career.
